items.text: Around the world, summers are getting hotter.
Day and night temperatures are increasing.
What impact could that be having on how we sleep?
Temperature and sleep are closely linked.
Typically, our bodies cool themselves down before we sleep.
One of the main ways that we do this is by widening blood vessels near the skin to allow heat to dissipate.

level1.label: 主语
level1.text: One of the main ways that we do this

items.text: In hot weather, this process becomes less effective as it is more difficult for heat to be transferred.

level1.label: 原因状语从句
level1.text: as it is more difficult for heat to be transferred

items.text: One of the body's mechanisms to speed up this process is by allowing sweat to evaporate.

level1.label: 主语
level1.text: One of the body's mechanisms to speed up this process

items.text: However, in humid conditions it's harder for evaporation to take place.
If the body is unable to cool down, then it's more difficult for people to fall asleep and more likely that sleep patterns can be disrupted.

level1.label: 条件状语从句
level1.text: If the body is unable to cool down

level1.label: 宾语从句
level1.text: that sleep patterns can be disrupted

items.text: This means that it's important for us to try to manage the temperature of the environment that we sleep in.

level1.label: 宾语从句
level1.text: that it's important for us to try to manage the temperature of the environment that we sleep in

level2.label: 主语从句
level2.text: for us to try to manage the temperature of the environment that we sleep in

items.text: While it can be costly, air conditioning is a useful tool to keep our sleeping environment cool.

level1.label: 表语
level1.text: a useful tool to keep our sleeping environment cool

level2.label: 后置定语
level2.text: to keep our sleeping environment cool

items.text: Managing ventilation is also important.
During the hottest hours of the day keeping windows and curtains closed can stop hot air and heat from sunlight entering our homes.

level1.label: 宾语
level1.text: hot air and heat from sunlight

items.text: At night, once the temperature has dropped, opening windows can allow cool air to come in and reduce the temperature in our homes.

level1.label: 宾语补足语
level1.text: to come in and reduce the temperature in our homes

items.text: Fans can help to speed up cooling, as long as air temperatures are low enough.

level1.label: 条件状语从句
level1.text: as long as air temperatures are low enough

items.text: They become less effective in hotter conditions.
It's not just rooms that we can cool down.

level1.label: 表语
level1.text: not just rooms that we can cool down

items.text: Using breathable bedding and sleepwear makes it easier for our bodies to regulate temperature.

level1.label: 宾语补足语
level1.text: easier for our bodies to regulate temperature

level2.label: 宾语从句
level2.text: for our bodies to regulate temperature

items.text: While it may seem counter-intuitive, it can be beneficial to have a warm bath or shower before sleep.

level1.label: 主语从句
level1.text: to have a warm bath or shower before sleep

items.text: Warm water can cause more blood to flow to our skin.
Once you get out of the bath or shower, this means that you cool down more quickly.

level1.label: 时间状语从句
level1.text: Once you get out of the bath or shower

level1.label: 宾语从句
level1.text: that you cool down more quickly

items.text: Another tip suggested by sleep experts Kevin Morgan and Lisa Artis is to cool your socks in the fridge and then put them on before going to sleep.

level1.label: 主语
level1.text: Another tip suggested by sleep experts Kevin Morgan and Lisa Artis

level1.label: 表语
level1.text: to cool your socks in the fridge and then put them on before going to sleep

level2.label: 后置定语
level2.text: suggested by sleep experts Kevin Morgan and Lisa Artis

items.text: They also say that it's important to try to keep to your usual sleep routine to avoid disruption to your sleep habits.

level1.label: 宾语从句
level1.text: that it's important to try to keep to your usual sleep routine to avoid disruption to your sleep habits

level2.label: 主语从句
level2.text: to try to keep to your usual sleep routine to avoid disruption to your sleep habits
